maria.g: Heads-up — CS flagged a visible regression in p95 TTFT for the text-generation endpoints this morning. Can someone point me to the exact Grafana panels + PromQL snippets for p50/p95/p99, TTFT, and tokens/sec so I can triage and share with them?

aj: @maria.g start with Grafana -> Observability / Latency / Generation (or search for 'generation_latency'). Also check 'Tokenflow' dashboard for tokens/sec. Snippets below.

aj: ```promql
# p95 request latency for generation routes (5m window)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=~"/v[0-9]+/generate"}[5m])) by (le))
```

lee_t: For TTFT we track first_token_time_seconds histogram. Use histogram_quantile similarly. 

lee_t: ```promql
# p95 time-to-first-token (TTFT)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(first_token_time_seconds_bucket{service="runtime",route=~"/v[0-9]+/generate"}[5m])) by (le))
```

nora: Jaeger quick links: https://jaeger.redwood.com/search?service=runtime&operation=GenerateStream — filter by trace duration and look for tags: cold_kv_miss, batch_size, model_variant. Loki query (logs):

nora: ```loki
{app="runtime",route=~"/v[0-9]+/generate"} | json | duration_ms > 800
```

ops-bot: Note: Canary rollout for hostpool manager happened at 2024-06-05T10:12Z (job/hostpool-upgrade). If you see coincident changes in latency, flag it.

maria.g: thanks. Any quick checks for tokens/sec drops vs GPU/CPU saturation? Customer mentioned throughput drop around same time.

aj: Check tokens emitted metric and GPU util. PromQL: 

aj: ```promql
# tokens/sec per pod (1m)
rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])

# GPU usage per pod (nvidia datasource example)
avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_utilization{job="k8s"}[5m]) by (pod)
```

lee_t: If batching changed, batch_size_distribution and batch_latency panels are useful. Also check kv_cache_hit_rate — a drop there causes cold starts that spike TTFT.

nora: FYI alert names and where they live: Alertmanager -> rules/ttft.rules.yml. The p95 alert is called "TTFTHigh_p95" (threshold 0.8s). For long-context customers we usually relax to 1.2s or add context-size tagging.

maria.g: good to know. I'm going to ping eng-runtime for a quick CR review on the prefetch change I linked in the ticket — might be related. @lee_t can you grab a sample trace & slice?

aj: sample trace id pulled: 4f3b2a7c9a2f (jump to Jaeger, paste id). shows a 950ms wait in kv_fetch on warmup path.

lee_t: grabbing logs now and will create a dashboard snapshot with the relevant panels (p50/p95/p99 TTFT, tokens/sec, GPU util, kv_cache_hit_rate). ETA ~30m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

nora: runbook note to add: when TTFT p95 spikes, check 1) kv_cache_hit_rate, 2) batch_size distribution, 3) recent canary or infra deploys, 4) trace tag cold_kv_miss.

maria.g: perfect — I'll update the ticket and include the Grafana/Jaeger/Loki links and the PromQL snippets. If we confirm cold_kv_miss, is the immediate mitigation to increase pre-warm threads or roll back canary?

lee_t: short-term rollback of hostpool change is safest if the canary window aligns. For a softer mitigation we can enable a small warmup pass to prepopulate KV for hot routes (requires a small runtime patch).

aj: adding to the ticket: steps to reproduce locally, PromQL used, trace id, and recommended mitigations.

maria.g: thanks everyone. I'll follow up with CS after the snapshot. If anything conclusive shows up before then @eng-runtime please post here.
